defects.cause: The unchanged negative token CLI throws immutable fixture drift to stderr and exits 1 without JSON stdout. Control incorrectly assumed JSON for negative results.
defects.repair: Preserve actual stdout/stderr/exit; parse only present JSON and require the exact immutable fixture diagnostic for the negative control.

defects.cause: Windows directory inode exceeds safe integer precision, so ino + 1 equals ino as Number; identity must use bigint stats.
defects.repair: Use bigint fs.stat for identity and deterministic +1n mismatch assertions.
